postings.title: Senior RF Design Engineer for Space Radar
top_requirements: Design RF front‑end schematics for radar sensors and take them through prototype board layout, assembly, and on‑orbit qualification.
Perform hands‑on RF lab measurements (noise figure, gain, IIP3, phase noise) and iterate component selection to meet stringent stability and power‑efficiency targets.
Lead design trade studies and create detailed test plans to validate RF performance across temperature and radiation extremes.
postings.summary: The role develops and qualifies RF electronics for space‑based radar, requiring end‑to‑end hardware design and testing. It matches the candidate’s RF and communications background while offering senior technical responsibility.

postings.title: Mixed Signal Verification Engineer
top_requirements: Create and execute verification test plans for high‑performance SoC blocks, including mixed‑signal interfaces and RF front‑ends.
Develop SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches that model analog behavior and validate timing, power, and functional specifications against silicon.
Collaborate with circuit designers to debug silicon failures, perform root‑cause analysis, and drive design fixes.
bonus_skills: Knowledge of Apple’s internal verification flow
postings.summary: Apple’s verification team ensures that complex SoCs meet performance specs, a hands‑on role that leverages the candidate’s mixed‑signal and RF verification experience. The compensation meets the target range.

postings.title: EDA and CAD Lead Engineer / Manager
top_requirements: Lead the development of mixed‑signal ASICs, overseeing schematic capture, layout, and sign‑off in a 28‑nm or finer process.
Drive hands‑on implementation of custom analog blocks, including bias circuits, regulators, and data converters, and mentor junior designers.
Coordinate with EDA tool teams to create custom flow extensions and improve design productivity across the group.
postings.summary: A lead engineering role at AttoTude that blends technical IC design with team leadership, fitting the candidate’s desire for senior IC responsibilities and offering competitive pay.

postings.title: Electronics Engineer
top_requirements: Design and prototype analog front‑ends for quantum‑sensor readout electronics, including low‑noise amplifiers and bias circuits.
Perform hardware bring‑up, calibration, and field validation of sensor modules in a laboratory environment.
Collaborate with quantum‑physics researchers to translate system requirements into robust electronic architectures.
bonus_skills: Knowledge of RF shielding and noise mitigation
postings.summary: A senior electronics engineer role at Q‑CTRL focusing on quantum sensor hardware, offering hands‑on circuit design away from aerospace and aligning with the candidate’s RF background.

postings.title: RF & Mixed-Signal Product & Test Engineer
top_requirements: Lead silicon debug and DOE definition for RF/mixed‑signal ASICs from pre‑silicon through mass production.
Develop automated test programs and data‑analytics pipelines to improve yield and characterize performance across process corners.
Coordinate cross‑functional teams (design, test, fab) to resolve failure modes and qualify products for high‑volume shipment.
postings.summary: A product and test engineering role at Qualcomm that involves hands‑on RF and mixed‑signal debugging, suitable for a senior engineer though compensation is modest for Singapore.

postings.title: Senior Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Designer – NVM & Memory IP
top_requirements: Design analog front‑ends and peripheral circuits for NVM memory IP, including sense amplifiers and reference generators.
Create layout guidance and perform post‑layout verification for high‑density memory arrays, ensuring timing and noise margins.
Develop test‑chip specifications, run silicon validation, and generate datasheets and characterization models for the IP.
postings.summary: An analog/mixed‑signal design role focused on NVM IP at RightSilicon, offering hands‑on circuit work that matches the candidate’s skill set, though compensation is lower than the target.
